name: ICNA Relief
mission: ICNA Relief USA seeks to alleviate human suffering by providing caring and compassionate service to victims of adversities and survivors of disasters. ICNA Relief USA strives to build healthy communities, strengthen families and create opportunities for those in despair while maintaining dignity and advocating for basic human needs.
theoryOfChange: ICNA Relief USA has an 'Effectiveness Assessment Policy' which states that the Board of Directors reviews its goals and objectives and completes a performance and effectiveness assessment of its programs every two years. This policy aims to ensure the organization has defined, measurable goals and objectives in place to evaluate the success and impact of its programs in fulfilling these goals and objectives. The assessment includes describing activities, identifying measures, analyzing effectiveness, and recommending future actions to increase effectiveness.

strengths_deep_dive: ICNA Relief demonstrates exemplary financial health and operational delivery. In FY2024, the charity achieved a <cite id="4">Program expense ratio of 88.5%</cite> on <cite id="4">Total Revenue of $58,008,025</cite>. Even when adjusting for non-cash gifts-in-kind, the organization's cash-adjusted program expense ratio of 88.5% comfortably surpasses the 75% industry benchmark. Furthermore, with <cite id="1">fundraising costs capped at $0.06 per $1 raised</cite>, donor contributions are converted directly into services. Serving over <cite id="14">1.1 million individuals</cite> with direct aid at under $50 per person underscores its cost-effective direct-service delivery model.
rich_narrative.summary: ICNA Relief USA operates as a major domestic humanitarian organization, delivering direct relief services across the United States. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="4">Total Revenue of $58,008,025</cite> to support key initiatives including health services, disaster relief, hunger prevention, transitional housing, and refugee support. Demonstrating exceptional operational efficiency, the charity achieved a <cite id="4">Program expense ratio of 88.5%</cite> in FY2024. When excluding non-cash contributions, its cash-adjusted program expense ratio stood at 88%, which exceeds the 75% industry standard and beats the peer median of 89.2%. ICNA Relief operates with high fundraising efficiency, spending just $0.04 to $0.06 per $1 raised. The organization serves over <cite id="14">1.1 million beneficiaries</cite> annually at a low estimated cost of $49.91 per beneficiary. It holds a <cite id="1">96.5/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite> and <cite id="2">verifies zakat eligibility</cite> across multiple traditional categories.
